title: Spanish-Style German Paella
description: A fusion of Spanish and German flavors, this paella recipe combines garlicky sausage with tender chicken and a hint of Spanish spices.

ingredients.name: Tender vegetables
ingredients.notes: Mixed bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes

instructions: Heat the al ajillo oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlicky sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tender chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Spanish paella rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the gambas broth and bring to a boil.
Add the tender vegetables, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
